Playbook.name: SWIFT — New Interactive or Remote Logon to a SWIFT Server - SOC Playbook

ExecutiveSummary.Overview: A new (account,host) interactive/remote logon to a SWIFT server was observed (4624, new_terms) - a first-seen access relationship to a payment asset. Triage: a newly-authorised operator/admin, or unauthorised access to a SWIFT server?
ExecutiveSummary.BusinessImpact: New access to a SWIFT server is inherently high-risk given the payment impact; unauthorised access is a serious incident.

Assets.AssetType: SWIFT Alliance payment servers (saa*, hq-sw-app*, hq-swift*)

LogSources.LogSource: Windows Security on SWIFT servers - logs-system.security-*

TelemetryRequirements.Requirement: Windows Security auditing on SWIFT hosts (verified live: saa76dr, hq-sw-app-p, hq-swift-accs-p, saa72live, hq-swift-web-p). SWIFT servers are the highest-value payment assets - any anomaly is high priority.

Signal.Name: New Interactive or Remote Logon to a SWI
Signal.Details: first-seen (account,host) logon to a SWIFT server.

InitialAssessment.Rule: Weigh the full evidence story per the ClassificationGuidance, not any single fact.

Investigation.Goal: Determine whether the new SWIFT-server logon is authorised access or an intrusion.

Step.name: The new logon: account, source, type
Step.Purpose: The account, source and logon type separate an authorised new operator from unauthorised access.
Step.Query: FROM logs-system.security-* | WHERE host.name == "$hostname" AND event.code == "4624" AND winlog.event_data.TargetUserName == "$username" AND @timestamp >= NOW() - 4 hours | EVAL src = COALESCE(TO_STRING(source.ip), "local") | STATS logons = COUNT(*), types = VALUES(winlog.event_data.LogonType), first_seen = MIN(@timestamp) BY src | SORT logons DESC | LIMIT 10
Step.AnalystNotes: A logon from an approved SWIFT jump host by a newly-onboarded operator is authorised. Interactive/RDP (type 2/10) from an unexpected source, or a non-SWIFT/admin account, is unauthorised access to a payment server.

Step.name: What the account did after logon
Step.Purpose: Post-logon tooling/changes on the SWIFT server escalate a new logon to an active incident.
Step.Query: FROM logs-system.security-* | WHERE host.name == "$hostname" AND winlog.event_data.TargetUserName == "$username" AND event.code IN ("4688","4697","4672") AND @timestamp >= NOW() - 4 hours | STATS c = COUNT(*), codes = VALUES(event.code) | LIMIT 5
Step.AnalystNotes: Process execution, service install or special privileges after the new logon indicate hands-on activity - correlate with PB-SWIFT-001/003.

Node.Condition: A new SWIFT-server logon from an unexpected source/account, especially with follow-on tooling/changes.
Node.Result: True Positive (Unauthorised SWIFT Access - CSP incident process, IR)

Node.Condition: A newly-onboarded, authorised SWIFT operator/admin from an approved jump host.
A new access relationship from a plausible source without an onboarding record.

DocumentationChecklist.Item: Attach outputs of INV-01-SWIFTLOGON-DETAIL, INV-02-SWIFTLOGON-ACTIONS to the case.

SOCAction.Item: Confirm onboarding; close as benign_activity; new_terms learns it.

TruePositive.Definition: Unauthorised access to a SWIFT server.

SOCAction.Item: Invoke the SWIFT CSP incident process; isolate; review payments; open IR.

Misconfiguration.Definition: A new access relationship pending verification.

SOCAction.Item: Verify with the SWIFT team; document.

Phase.name: Immediate Actions (0-30 minutes)
Phase.Action: Confirm the activity on the SWIFT server; SWIFT anomalies are high priority.
If unauthorised, isolate per the SWIFT CSP incident process.

Phase.name: Containment and Eradication (hours)
Phase.Action: Isolate the SWIFT server per the CSP incident process; preserve evidence; engage the SWIFT/payments team; open IR.

Phase.name: Recovery and Hardening (days)
Phase.Action: Enforce SWIFT CSP controls: restricted access, MFA/jump-host, allowlisted software, segregation from the general network.

QualityChecks.Check: SWIFT servers are in-scope for the SWIFT Customer Security Programme - treat every anomaly as high priority and involve the payments team.

TruePositiveClosure.Item: Unauthorised access contained per CSP; payments reviewed.
